criteria.label: Transaction map
criteria.description: Accurately maps the parties, structure, approvals, and closing sequence.

criteria.label: Diligence issue log
criteria.description: Identifies at least twelve case-specific issues and explains their consequence.

criteria.label: Targeted request list
criteria.description: Requests evidence that resolves the identified risks.

criteria.label: Associate summary
criteria.description: States readiness, gating issues, next workstream, and specialist input.

criteria.label: Evidence-grounded prompting
criteria.description: Uses packet references and asks the AI to connect advice to source evidence.

criteria.label: Verification and challenge
criteria.description: Checks AI claims and corrects unsupported or inaccurate suggestions.

criteria.label: Professional judgment
criteria.description: Uses AI as support without delegating the final legal judgment.
